<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>Morning Checks Daily</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/7292611C-E519-4CA4-A084-97C2D36644A6" uiVersion="1" version="1" name="Morning Checks Daily">
					<airblower>
						<airblower />
					</airblower>
					<ou_pressure>
						<ou_pressure_chk />
					</ou_pressure>
					<gas_piping_dig>
						<main_gas_valve_chk />
						<parallel_digester_valve_chk />
						<digester_condense_chk />
					</gas_piping_dig>
					<air_release>
						<air_release_chk />
					</air_release>
					<gas_piping_chp>
						<parallel_valve_chp_chk />
						<chp_condense_chk />
					</gas_piping_chp>
					<flare>
						<flare_main_chk />
						<flare_sample_valve />
					</flare>
					<chp>
						<chp_kwh />
						<chp_total_run_hours />
					</chp>
					<chp2>
						<chp2_kwh />
						<chp2_total_run_hours />
					</chp2>
					<cntrl_panel>
						<cntrl_panel_switch_chk />
						<desul_panel_valve_chk />
					</cntrl_panel>
				</data>
			</instance>
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/airblower" nodeset="/data/airblower" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/airblower/airblower" nodeset="/data/airblower/airblower" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/ou_pressure" nodeset="/data/ou_pressure" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/ou_pressure/ou_pressure_chk" nodeset="/data/ou_pressure/ou_pressure_chk" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/gas_piping_dig" nodeset="/data/gas_piping_dig" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/gas_piping_dig/main_gas_valve_chk" nodeset="/data/gas_piping_dig/main_gas_valve_chk" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/gas_piping_dig/parallel_digester_valve_chk" nodeset="/data/gas_piping_dig/parallel_digester_valve_chk" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/gas_piping_dig/digester_condense_chk" nodeset="/data/gas_piping_dig/digester_condense_chk" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/air_release" nodeset="/data/air_release" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/air_release/air_release_chk" nodeset="/data/air_release/air_release_chk" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/gas_piping_chp" nodeset="/data/gas_piping_chp" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/gas_piping_chp/parallel_valve_chp_chk" nodeset="/data/gas_piping_chp/parallel_valve_chp_chk" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/gas_piping_chp/chp_condense_chk" nodeset="/data/gas_piping_chp/chp_condense_chk" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/flare" nodeset="/data/flare" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/flare/flare_main_chk" nodeset="/data/flare/flare_main_chk" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/flare/flare_sample_valve" nodeset="/data/flare/flare_sample_valve" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp" nodeset="/data/chp" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp/chp_kwh" nodeset="/data/chp/chp_kwh" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp/chp_total_run_hours" nodeset="/data/chp/chp_total_run_hours" type="xsd:int" vellum:constraint=". < #form/chp/chp_kwh" constraint=". < /data/chp/chp_kwh" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp2" nodeset="/data/chp2" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp2/chp2_kwh" nodeset="/data/chp2/chp2_kwh" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp2/chp2_total_run_hours" nodeset="/data/chp2/chp2_total_run_hours" type="xsd:int" vellum:constraint=". < #form/chp2/chp2_kwh" constraint=". < /data/chp2/chp2_kwh" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/cntrl_panel" nodeset="/data/cntrl_panel" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/cntrl_panel/cntrl_panel_switch_chk" nodeset="/data/cntrl_panel/cntrl_panel_switch_chk" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/cntrl_panel/desul_panel_valve_chk" nodeset="/data/cntrl_panel/desul_panel_valve_chk" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="airblower-label">
						<value>Airblower</value>
					</text>
					<text id="airblower/airblower-airblower_chk-label">
						<value>Please check valve of airblower</value>
					</text>
					<text id="ou_pressure-label">
						<value>Over/Under pressure device</value>
					</text>
					<text id="ou_pressure/ou_pressure_chk-ou_water_level-label">
						<value>Please check water level on both tubes and fill if needed</value>
					</text>
					<text id="gas_piping_dig-label">
						<value>Gas Piping</value>
					</text>
					<text id="gas_piping_dig/main_gas_valve_chk-main_gas_valve_chk-label">
						<value>Please check main gas valve</value>
					</text>
					<text id="gas_piping_dig/parallel_digester_valve_chk-parrallel_digester_valve_chk-label">
						<value>Please check the parallel valve at digester</value>
					</text>
					<text id="gas_piping_dig/digester_condense_chk-parralel_digester_valve_chk-label">
						<value>Check condense pit at digester</value>
					</text>
					<text id="air_release-label">
						<value>Air release valve</value>
					</text>
					<text id="air_release/air_release_chk-air_release_chk-label">
						<value>Please check air release valve</value>
					</text>
					<text id="gas_piping_chp-label">
						<value>Gas piping</value>
					</text>
					<text id="gas_piping_chp/parallel_valve_chp_chk-parrallel_digester_valve_chk-label">
						<value>Confirm setting for CHP parallel valves</value>
					</text>
					<text id="gas_piping_chp/chp_condense_chk-parralel_digester_valve_chk-label">
						<value>Check condense pit at CHP</value>
					</text>
					<text id="flare-label">
						<value>Flare</value>
					</text>
					<text id="flare/flare_main_chk-flare_main_chk-label">
						<value>Please check flare main valve (black)</value>
					</text>
					<text id="flare/flare_sample_valve-flare_main_chk-label">
						<value>Please check flare sample valve (small yellow)</value>
					</text>
					<text id="chp-label">
						<value>CHP1</value>
					</text>
					<text id="chp/chp_kwh-label">
						<value>**CHP1** total **kWh** reading</value>
						<value form="markdown">**CHP1** total **kWh** reading</value>
					</text>
					<text id="chp/chp_total_run_hours-label">
						<value>**CHP1** total **run** hours</value>
						<value form="markdown">**CHP1** total **run** hours</value>
					</text>
					<text id="chp2-label">
						<value>CHP2</value>
					</text>
					<text id="chp2/chp2_kwh-label">
						<value>**CHP2** total **kWh** reading</value>
						<value form="markdown">**CHP2** total **kWh** reading</value>
					</text>
					<text id="chp2/chp2_total_run_hours-label">
						<value>**CHP2** total **run** hours</value>
						<value form="markdown">**CHP2** total **run** hours</value>
					</text>
					<text id="cntrl_panel-label">
						<value>Control Panel</value>
					</text>
					<text id="cntrl_panel/cntrl_panel_switch_chk-cntrl_panel_swith_chk-label">
						<value>Please switch on control panel</value>
					</text>
					<text id="cntrl_panel/desul_panel_valve_chk-cntrl_panel_valve_chk-label">
						<value>Please make sure desulpharization main valve is closed when not pumping.</value>
					</text>
				</translation>
			</itext>
		</model>
	</h:head>
	<h:body>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/airblower" ref="/data/airblower" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('airblower-label')" />
			<select vellum:ref="#form/airblower/airblower" ref="/data/airblower/airblower">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('airblower/airblower-airblower_chk-label')" />
					<value>airblower_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
		</group>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/ou_pressure" ref="/data/ou_pressure" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('ou_pressure-label')" />
			<select vellum:ref="#form/ou_pressure/ou_pressure_chk" ref="/data/ou_pressure/ou_pressure_chk">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('ou_pressure/ou_pressure_chk-ou_water_level-label')" />
					<value>ou_water_level</value>
				</item>
			</select>
		</group>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/gas_piping_dig" ref="/data/gas_piping_dig" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('gas_piping_dig-label')" />
			<select vellum:ref="#form/gas_piping_dig/main_gas_valve_chk" ref="/data/gas_piping_dig/main_gas_valve_chk">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('gas_piping_dig/main_gas_valve_chk-main_gas_valve_chk-label')" />
					<value>main_gas_valve_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
			<select vellum:ref="#form/gas_piping_dig/parallel_digester_valve_chk" ref="/data/gas_piping_dig/parallel_digester_valve_chk">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('gas_piping_dig/parallel_digester_valve_chk-parrallel_digester_valve_chk-label')" />
					<value>parrallel_digester_valve_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
			<select vellum:ref="#form/gas_piping_dig/digester_condense_chk" ref="/data/gas_piping_dig/digester_condense_chk">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('gas_piping_dig/digester_condense_chk-parralel_digester_valve_chk-label')" />
					<value>parralel_digester_valve_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
		</group>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/air_release" ref="/data/air_release" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('air_release-label')" />
			<select vellum:ref="#form/air_release/air_release_chk" ref="/data/air_release/air_release_chk">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('air_release/air_release_chk-air_release_chk-label')" />
					<value>air_release_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
		</group>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/gas_piping_chp" ref="/data/gas_piping_chp" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('gas_piping_chp-label')" />
			<select vellum:ref="#form/gas_piping_chp/parallel_valve_chp_chk" ref="/data/gas_piping_chp/parallel_valve_chp_chk">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('gas_piping_chp/parallel_valve_chp_chk-parrallel_digester_valve_chk-label')" />
					<value>parrallel_digester_valve_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
			<select vellum:ref="#form/gas_piping_chp/chp_condense_chk" ref="/data/gas_piping_chp/chp_condense_chk">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('gas_piping_chp/chp_condense_chk-parralel_digester_valve_chk-label')" />
					<value>parralel_digester_valve_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
		</group>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/flare" ref="/data/flare" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('flare-label')" />
			<select vellum:ref="#form/flare/flare_main_chk" ref="/data/flare/flare_main_chk">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('flare/flare_main_chk-flare_main_chk-label')" />
					<value>flare_main_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
			<select vellum:ref="#form/flare/flare_sample_valve" ref="/data/flare/flare_sample_valve">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('flare/flare_sample_valve-flare_main_chk-label')" />
					<value>flare_main_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
		</group>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/chp" ref="/data/chp" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('chp-label')" />
			<input vellum:ref="#form/chp/chp_kwh" ref="/data/chp/chp_kwh">
				<label ref="jr:itext('chp/chp_kwh-label')" />
			</input>
			<input vellum:ref="#form/chp/chp_total_run_hours" ref="/data/chp/chp_total_run_hours">
				<label ref="jr:itext('chp/chp_total_run_hours-label')" />
			</input>
		</group>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/chp2" ref="/data/chp2" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('chp2-label')" />
			<input vellum:ref="#form/chp2/chp2_kwh" ref="/data/chp2/chp2_kwh">
				<label ref="jr:itext('chp2/chp2_kwh-label')" />
			</input>
			<input vellum:ref="#form/chp2/chp2_total_run_hours" ref="/data/chp2/chp2_total_run_hours">
				<label ref="jr:itext('chp2/chp2_total_run_hours-label')" />
			</input>
		</group>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/cntrl_panel" ref="/data/cntrl_panel" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('cntrl_panel-label')" />
			<select vellum:ref="#form/cntrl_panel/cntrl_panel_switch_chk" ref="/data/cntrl_panel/cntrl_panel_switch_chk">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('cntrl_panel/cntrl_panel_switch_chk-cntrl_panel_swith_chk-label')" />
					<value>cntrl_panel_swith_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
			<select vellum:ref="#form/cntrl_panel/desul_panel_valve_chk" ref="/data/cntrl_panel/desul_panel_valve_chk">
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('cntrl_panel/desul_panel_valve_chk-cntrl_panel_valve_chk-label')" />
					<value>cntrl_panel_valve_chk</value>
				</item>
			</select>
		</group>
	</h:body>
</h:html>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>Metering Round</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/1C3FE6EF-6263-4DE9-9CA6-444EB945F0EA" uiVersion="1" version="1" name="Metering Round">
					<week_month>
						<type_of_round />
						<week />
						<month />
					</week_month>
					<gwc>
						<watermeter />
					</gwc>
					<toilet_water>
						<toilet_water_meter />
					</toilet_water>
					<ecg>
						<ecg_import />
						<ecg_export />
					</ecg>
					<chp>
						<chp_kwh />
						<chp_total_run_hours />
					</chp>
					<chp2>
						<chp2_kwh />
						<chp2_total_run_hours />
					</chp2>
					<diesel_gen>
						<diesel_gen_fuel_chk />
						<diesel_gen_opshours />
					</diesel_gen>
					<kc>
						<kc_kwh_main />
						<kc_kwh_solar />
					</kc>
					<greenhouse>
						<tables_in_use />
						<percentage_in_use />
						<greenhouse_for__percentage_in_use__in_use />
					</greenhouse>
				</data>
			</instance>
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/week_month" nodeset="/data/week_month" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/week_month/type_of_round" nodeset="/data/week_month/type_of_round" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/week_month/week" nodeset="/data/week_month/week" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/week_month/month" nodeset="/data/week_month/month" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/gwc" nodeset="/data/gwc" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/gwc/watermeter" nodeset="/data/gwc/watermeter" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/toilet_water" nodeset="/data/toilet_water" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/toilet_water/toilet_water_meter" nodeset="/data/toilet_water/toilet_water_meter" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/ecg" nodeset="/data/ecg" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/ecg/ecg_import" nodeset="/data/ecg/ecg_import" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/ecg/ecg_export" nodeset="/data/ecg/ecg_export" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp" nodeset="/data/chp" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp/chp_kwh" nodeset="/data/chp/chp_kwh" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp/chp_total_run_hours" nodeset="/data/chp/chp_total_run_hours" type="xsd:int" vellum:constraint=". < #form/chp/chp_kwh" constraint=". < /data/chp/chp_kwh" jr:constraintMsg="jr:itext('chp/chp_total_run_hours-constraintMsg')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp2" nodeset="/data/chp2" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp2/chp2_kwh" nodeset="/data/chp2/chp2_kwh" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/chp2/chp2_total_run_hours" nodeset="/data/chp2/chp2_total_run_hours" type="xsd:int" vellum:constraint=". < #form/chp2/chp2_kwh" constraint=". < /data/chp2/chp2_kwh" jr:constraintMsg="jr:itext('chp2/chp2_total_run_hours-constraintMsg')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/diesel_gen" nodeset="/data/diesel_gen" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/diesel_gen/diesel_gen_fuel_chk" nodeset="/data/diesel_gen/diesel_gen_fuel_chk" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/diesel_gen/diesel_gen_opshours" nodeset="/data/diesel_gen/diesel_gen_opshours" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/kc" nodeset="/data/kc" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/kc/kc_kwh_main" nodeset="/data/kc/kc_kwh_main" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/kc/kc_kwh_solar" nodeset="/data/kc/kc_kwh_solar" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/greenhouse" nodeset="/data/greenhouse" vellum:relevant="selected(#form/week_month/week, 'week')" relevant="selected(/data/week_month/week, 'week')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/greenhouse/tables_in_use" nodeset="/data/greenhouse/tables_in_use" type="xsd:int" constraint=". >= 0 and . <= 34" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/greenhouse/percentage_in_use" nodeset="/data/greenhouse/percentage_in_use" vellum:calculate="int((#form/greenhouse/tables_in_use div 34) * 100)" calculate="int((/data/greenhouse/tables_in_use div 34) * 100)" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/greenhouse/greenhouse_for__percentage_in_use__in_use" nodeset="/data/greenhouse/greenhouse_for__percentage_in_use__in_use" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="week_month-label">
						<value>Round type</value>
					</text>
					<text id="week_month/type_of_round-label">
						<value>Weekly or Monthly round?
</value>
					</text>
					<text id="week_month/week-week-label">
						<value>week</value>
					</text>
					<text id="week_month/month-month-label">
						<value>month</value>
					</text>
					<text id="gwc-label">
						<value>Ghana Water Company</value>
					</text>
					<text id="gwc/watermeter-label">
						<value>**GWC** meter reading (m3)</value>
						<value form="markdown">**GWC** meter reading (m3)</value>
					</text>
					<text id="toilet_water-label">
						<value>Toilet Water Meter</value>
					</text>
					<text id="toilet_water/toilet_water_meter-label">
						<value>**Toilet** Meter Reading (m3)</value>
						<value form="markdown">**Toilet** Meter Reading (m3)</value>
					</text>
					<text id="toilet_water/toilet_water_meter-help">
						<value>state water meter reading at the toilet (m3)</value>
					</text>
					<text id="ecg-label">
						<value>ECG meter (below transformer)</value>
					</text>
					<text id="ecg/ecg_import-label">
						<value>Import kWh</value>
					</text>
					<text id="ecg/ecg_import-help">
						<value>state **import** kWh on ECG meter at trafo</value>
						<value form="markdown">state **import** kWh on ECG meter at trafo</value>
					</text>
					<text id="ecg/ecg_export-label">
						<value>export kWh</value>
					</text>
					<text id="ecg/ecg_export-help">
						<value>state **export** kWh on ECG meter at trafo</value>

<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>Incident and risk registration</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>

						<name />
					</time_type>
					<description>
						<type_incident />
						<description />
					</description>
					<actions>
						<first_aid_applied />
						<immediate_action />
					</actions>
				</data>
			</instance>
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/time_type" nodeset="/data/time_type" />

			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/time_type/name" nodeset="/data/time_type/name" type="xsd:string" required="true()" />

				<translation lang="en" default="">

					</text>

					</text>
					<text id="description/type_incident-near_miss-label">

					</text>

					</text>

					</text>

			</itext>

				</item>

					<value>observation</value>
				</item>
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('description/type_incident-injury-label')" />
					<value>injury</value>
				</item>
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('description/type_incident-risk-label')" />
					<value>risk</value>
				</item>
			</select1>
			<input vellum:ref="#form/description/description" ref="/data/description/description">

				<hint ref="jr:itext('description/description-hint')" />

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>Batch Tracking</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/04586A1E-25A2-4CEE-B08D-1E047E82D2EB" uiVersion="1" version="1" name="Batch Tracking">
					<uuid />
					<last_tracking_date />
					<temperature>
						<temp_1 />
						<temp_2 />
						<temp_3 />
						<average_temp />
					</temperature>
					<average_temp />
					<moisture>
						<adding_moisture />
						<Added_moisture />
					</moisture>
					<Nuisance>
						<Odour />
						<flies />
					</Nuisance>
					<special_remarks>
						<remarks />
						<specify />
					</special_remarks>
					<intend_closing />
					<closing>
						<closing_measurements>
							<close_ph />
							<close_ec />
							<quantity_raw_compost_produced />
						</closing_measurements>
						<quality_check />
						<quality_check_gr>
							<temp_msg />
							<ph_msg />
							<ec_msg />
							<qualtiy_check_result />
							<quality_msg_true />
							<quality_msg_false />
							<force_close />
							<force_closing />
							<close_case />
							<phase />
							<test vellum:comment="for debugging purpose only" />
						</quality_check_gr>
						<comp_closing_remark />
					</closing>
				</data>
			</instance>
			<instance src="jr://instance/casedb" id="casedb" />
			<instance src="jr://instance/session" id="commcaresession" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/uuid" nodeset="/data/uuid" vellum:calculate="#case/uuid" calculate="instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/uuid" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/last_tracking_date" nodeset="/data/last_tracking_date" calculate="now()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/temperature" nodeset="/data/temperature" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/temperature/temp_1" nodeset="/data/temperature/temp_1" type="xsd:int" constraint=". > 0 and . < 100" jr:constraintMsg="jr:itext('temperature/temp_1-constraintMsg')" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/temperature/temp_2" nodeset="/data/temperature/temp_2" type="xsd:int" constraint=". > 0 and . < 100" jr:constraintMsg="jr:itext('temperature/temp_2-constraintMsg')" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/temperature/temp_3" nodeset="/data/temperature/temp_3" type="xsd:int" constraint=". > 0 and . < 100" jr:constraintMsg="jr:itext('temperature/temp_3-constraintMsg')" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/temperature/average_temp" nodeset="/data/temperature/average_temp" vellum:calculate="int((#form/temperature/temp_1 + #form/temperature/temp_2 + #form/temperature/temp_3) div 3)" calculate="int((/data/temperature/temp_1 + /data/temperature/temp_2 + /data/temperature/temp_3) div 3)" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/average_temp" nodeset="/data/average_temp" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/moisture" nodeset="/data/moisture" relevant="false()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/moisture/adding_moisture" nodeset="/data/moisture/adding_moisture" required="false()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/moisture/Added_moisture" nodeset="/data/moisture/Added_moisture" type="xsd:int" vellum:relevant="#form/moisture/adding_moisture = 'digestate' or #form/moisture/adding_moisture = 'water'" relevant="/data/moisture/adding_moisture = 'digestate' or /data/moisture/adding_moisture = 'water'" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/Nuisance" nodeset="/data/Nuisance" relevant="false()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/Nuisance/Odour" nodeset="/data/Nuisance/Odour" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/Nuisance/flies" nodeset="/data/Nuisance/flies" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/special_remarks" nodeset="/data/special_remarks" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/special_remarks/remarks" nodeset="/data/special_remarks/remarks" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/special_remarks/specify" nodeset="/data/special_remarks/specify" type="xsd:string" vellum:relevant="#form/special_remarks/remarks = 'yes'" relevant="/data/special_remarks/remarks = 'yes'" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/intend_closing" nodeset="/data/intend_closing" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing" nodeset="/data/closing" vellum:relevant="#form/intend_closing = 'yes'" relevant="/data/intend_closing = 'yes'" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/closing_measurements" nodeset="/data/closing/closing_measurements" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/closing_measurements/close_ph" nodeset="/data/closing/closing_measurements/close_ph" type="xsd:double" constraint=". <= 14 and regex(., '^[0-9]*(\.[0-9]?)?$')" jr:constraintMsg="jr:itext('closing/closing_measurements/close_ph-constraintMsg')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/closing_measurements/close_ec" nodeset="/data/closing/closing_measurements/close_ec" type="xsd:double" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/closing_measurements/quantity_raw_compost_produced" nodeset="/data/closing/closing_measurements/quantity_raw_compost_produced" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check" vellum:calculate="if(#form/temperature/average_temp < 45 and #form/closing/closing_measurements/close_ph < 10., true(), false())" calculate="if(/data/temperature/average_temp < 45 and /data/closing/closing_measurements/close_ph < 10., true(), false())" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/temp_msg" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/temp_msg" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/ph_msg" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/ph_msg" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/ec_msg" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/ec_msg" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/qualtiy_check_result" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/qualtiy_check_result" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/quality_msg_true" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/quality_msg_true" vellum:relevant="#form/closing/quality_check = true()" relevant="/data/closing/quality_check = true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/quality_msg_false" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/quality_msg_false" vellum:relevant="#form/closing/quality_check = false()" relevant="/data/closing/quality_check = false()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/force_close" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/force_close" vellum:constraint=". = 'no' or if(. = 'yes' or #form/closing/quality_check_gr/force_closing = 'force', true(), false())" constraint=". = 'no' or if(. = 'yes' or /data/closing/quality_check_gr/force_closing = 'force', true(), false())" vellum:relevant="#form/closing/quality_check = false()" relevant="/data/closing/quality_check = false()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/force_closing" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/force_closing" vellum:relevant="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/force_close = 'yes'" relevant="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/force_close = 'yes'" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/close_case" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/close_case" vellum:calculate="if(#form/closing/quality_check = true() or #form/closing/quality_check_gr/force_close = 'yes', true(), false())" calculate="if(/data/closing/quality_check = true() or /data/closing/quality_check_gr/force_close = 'yes', true(), false())" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/phase" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/phase" vellum:relevant="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/close_case = true()" relevant="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/close_case = true()" vellum:calculate="if(#form/closing/quality_check_gr/close_case = true(), 'bagging', '')" calculate="if(/data/closing/quality_check_gr/close_case = true(), 'bagging', '')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/test" nodeset="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/test" relevant="false()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/closing/comp_closing_remark" nodeset="/data/closing/comp_closing_remark" type="xsd:string" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/intend_closing" ref="/data/intend_closing" value="'no'" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/force_close" ref="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/force_close" value="'no'" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="temperature-label">
						<value>Measure the temperature three times</value>
					</text>

						<value>Please check temperature (range 0 - 100)</value>

					</text>
					<text id="temperature/temp_2-constraintMsg">
						<value>Please check temperature (range 0 - 100)</value>
					</text>

						<value>Temperature 3 (in Celcius)</value>
					</text>

						<value>Please check temperature (range 0 - 100)</value>
					</text>

### <output value="/data/temperature/average_temp" vellum:value="#form/temperature/average_temp" /> C</value>

### <output value="/data/temperature/average_temp" vellum:value="#form/temperature/average_temp" /> C</value>

						<value>**Yes:** Digestate</value>
						<value form="markdown">**Yes:** Digestate</value>
					</text>
					<text id="moisture/adding_moisture-water-label">
						<value>**Yes:** Water</value>
						<value form="markdown">**Yes:** Water</value>
					</text>
					<text id="moisture/adding_moisture-no-label">
						<value>**No**</value>
						<value form="markdown">**No**</value>
					</text>
					<text id="moisture/Added_moisture-label">
						<value>Added quantity (in liters)</value>
					</text>
					<text id="moisture/Added_moisture-hint">
						<value>If no water added, leave empty</value>
					</text>
					<text id="Nuisance/Odour-label">
						<value>What is the odour?</value>
					</text>
					<text id="Nuisance/Odour-no_smell-label">
						<value>No smell</value>
					</text>
					<text id="Nuisance/Odour-sligthly_smelly-label">
						<value>Slightly smelly</value>
					</text>
					<text id="Nuisance/Odour-very_smelly-label">
						<value>Very smelly</value>
					</text>

						<value>Are there flies?</value>

					<text id="Nuisance/flies-no_flies-label">

					<text id="special_remarks/remarks-label">

					<text id="special_remarks/remarks-yes-label">
						<value>Yes</value>
					</text>
					<text id="special_remarks/remarks-no-label">
						<value>No</value>
					</text>
					<text id="special_remarks/specify-label">
						<value>Please, specify</value>

					<text id="intend_closing-label">
						<value>Do you intend to close the batch?</value>

						<value>Closing measurements</value>

						<value form="markdown">The avg temperature is:  **<output value="/data/temperature/average_temp" vellum:value="#form/temperature/average_temp" /> C**</value>
					</text>
					<text id="closing/quality_check_gr/ph_msg-label">
						<value>Measure pH is: **<output value="/data/closing/closing_measurements/close_ph" vellum:value="#form/closing/closing_measurements/close_ph" />**</value>
						<value form="markdown">Measure pH is: **<output value="/data/closing/closing_measurements/close_ph" vellum:value="#form/closing/closing_measurements/close_ph" />**</value>
					</text>
					<text id="closing/quality_check_gr/ec_msg-label">
						<value>The measure EC is: **<output value="/data/closing/closing_measurements/close_ec" vellum:value="#form/closing/closing_measurements/close_ec" />**</value>

## **<output value="/data/closing/quality_check" vellum:value="#form/closing/quality_check" />**</value>

						<value>
Please proceed in closing the case </value>
					</text>
					<text id="closing/quality_check_gr/quality_msg_false-label">
						<value>
The measurements are not within quality range</value>

<output value="/data/closing/quality_check_gr/phase" vellum:value="#form/closing/quality_check_gr/phase" /> </value>

	<h:body>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/temperature" ref="/data/temperature" appearance="field-list">
			<label ref="jr:itext('temperature-label')" />
			<input vellum:ref="#form/temperature/temp_1" ref="/data/temperature/temp_1">
				<label ref="jr:itext('temperature/temp_1-label')" />
				<alert ref="jr:itext('temperature/temp_1-constraintMsg')" />
			</input>
			<input vellum:ref="#form/temperature/temp_2" ref="/data/temperature/temp_2">
				<label ref="jr:itext('temperature/temp_2-label')" />
				<alert ref="jr:itext('temperature/temp_2-constraintMsg')" />
			</input>

				<alert ref="jr:itext('temperature/temp_3-constraintMsg')" />

		</trigger>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/moisture" ref="/data/moisture" appearance="field-list">

				</item>
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('moisture/adding_moisture-water-label')" />
					<value>water</value>
				</item>
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('moisture/adding_moisture-no-label')" />
					<value>no</value>
				</item>
			</select1>
			<input vellum:ref="#form/moisture/Added_moisture" ref="/data/moisture/Added_moisture">
				<label ref="jr:itext('moisture/Added_moisture-label')" />
				<hint ref="jr:itext('moisture/Added_moisture-hint')" />
			</input>
		</group>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/Nuisance" ref="/data/Nuisance" appearance="field-list">

					<label ref="jr:itext('Nuisance/Odour-no_smell-label')" />
					<value>no_smell</value>
				</item>
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('Nuisance/Odour-sligthly_smelly-label')" />
					<value>sligthly_smelly</value>
				</item>
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('Nuisance/Odour-very_smelly-label')" />
					<value>very_smelly</value>
				</item>
			</select1>
			<select1 vellum:ref="#form/Nuisance/flies" ref="/data/Nuisance/flies">

			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/bagging/summary_bagging" nodeset="/data/bagging/summary_bagging" />

old bags filled:  <output value="instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/bags_filled_total" vellum:value="#case/bags_filled_total" />

In **total** up to now *<output value="/data/bagging/new_bags_filled" vellum:value="#form/bagging/new_bags_filled" />*  bags (*<output value="/data/bagging/new_kg_bagged" vellum:value="#form/bagging/new_kg_bagged" />*  kg)  have been processed</value>
						<value form="markdown">#Summary:
old bags filled:  <output value="instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/bags_filled_total" vellum:value="#case/bags_filled_total" />

*<output value="/data/bagging/bags_filled" vellum:value="#form/bagging/bags_filled" />*  bags are filled which is *<output value="/data/bagging/kg_bagged" vellum:value="#form/bagging/kg_bagged" />* kg
In **total** up to now *<output value="/data/bagging/new_bags_filled" vellum:value="#form/bagging/new_bags_filled" />*  bags (*<output value="/data/bagging/new_kg_bagged" vellum:value="#form/bagging/new_kg_bagged" />*  kg)  have been processed</value>
					</text>
					<text id="bagging/last_material_processed-label">

					<text id="bagging/last_material_processed-no-label">

						<value>Yes (means batch will be closed!)</value>

	</h:head>
	<h:body>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/bagging" ref="/data/bagging" appearance="field-list">

			<input vellum:ref="#form/bagging/bags_filled" ref="/data/bagging/bags_filled">
				<label ref="jr:itext('bagging/bags_filled-label')" />
			</input>
			<trigger vellum:ref="#form/bagging/summary_bagging" ref="/data/bagging/summary_bagging" appearance="minimal">
				<label ref="jr:itext('bagging/summary_bagging-label')" />
			</trigger>
			<select1 vellum:ref="#form/bagging/last_material_processed" ref="/data/bagging/last_material_processed">
				<label ref="jr:itext('bagging/last_material_processed-label')" />
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('bagging/last_material_processed-no-label')" />
					<value>no</value>
				</item>
				<item>
					<label ref="jr:itext('bagging/last_material_processed-yes-label')" />
					<value>yes</value>
				</item>

		</group>
	</h:body>
</h:html>

<h:html xmlns:h="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:orx="http://openrosa.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2002/xforms" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:jr="http://openrosa.org/javarosa" xmlns:vellum="http://commcarehq.org/xforms/vellum">
	<h:head>
		<h:title>New Order</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/44CA241B-D4DA-46EA-A958-EDD86297AADC" uiVersion="1" version="1" name="New Order">
					<client>

							<plant_date />
							<sub_order_id />

							<Summary />

						</seedling_order_summary>

							<bags />

						<compost_weight_sum_bags />
						<compost_total_order_weigth />

				</data>
			</instance>

			<instance src="jr://fixture/item-list:seedling_variety" id="seedling_variety" />

			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/client/order_number" nodeset="/data/client/order_number" calculate="format-date(now(), '%y%m%d%h%M')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/client/client" nodeset="/data/client/client" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/client/what_to_order" nodeset="/data/client/what_to_order" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch" vellum:relevant="selected(#form/client/what_to_order, 'seedlings')" relevant="selected(/data/client/what_to_order, 'seedlings')" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch/position_count" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch/position_count" calculate="position(..) + 1" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch/batch_input" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch/batch_input" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch/batch_input/crop" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch/batch_input/crop" required="true()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch/batch_input/variety" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch/batch_input/variety" required="true()" />

			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/plant_date" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/plant_date" vellum:calculate="date(#form/seedling_batch/when_needed - #form/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/cycle_time)" calculate="date(/data/seedling_batch/when_needed - /data/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/cycle_time)" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/sub_order_id" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/sub_order_id" vellum:calculate="concat(#form/client/order_number1, '.', #form/seedling_batch/position_count)" calculate="concat(/data/client/order_number1, '.', /data/seedling_batch/position_count)" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/count" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/count" vellum:calculate="count(#form/seedling_batch)" calculate="count(/data/seedling_batch)" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/Summary" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/Summary" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/order_summary" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/order_summary" relevant="false()" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/variety_specscycle_time_cycle_time_days" nodeset="/data/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/variety_specscycle_time_cycle_time_days" />

			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/compost_order/bags/compost_delivery_date" nodeset="/data/compost_order/bags/compost_delivery_date" type="xsd:date" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/compost_order/order_no_of_bags_remaining" nodeset="/data/compost_order/order_no_of_bags_remaining" vellum:calculate="#form/compost_order/bags/bags" calculate="/data/compost_order/bags/bags" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/compost_order/compost_weight_sum_bags" nodeset="/data/compost_order/compost_weight_sum_bags" vellum:calculate="#form/compost_order/bags/bags * 30" calculate="/data/compost_order/bags/bags * 30" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/compost_order/compost_total_order_weigth" nodeset="/data/compost_order/compost_total_order_weigth" vellum:calculate="#form/compost_order/bags/bags * 30" calculate="/data/compost_order/bags/bags * 30" />
			<setvalue event="xforms-ready" vellum:ref="#form/client/order_number1" ref="/data/client/order_number1" value="format-date(now(), '%y%m%d%h%M')" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="client/order_number1-label">

						<value>Seedlings</value>
					</text>
					<text id="client/what_to_order-compost_bags-label">
						<value>Compost Bags</value>
					</text>
					<text id="seedling_batch-label">
						<value>Seedling Batch</value>
					</text>
					<text id="seedling_batch/batch_input/crop-label">
						<value>Crop</value>
					</text>
					<text id="seedling_batch/batch_input/variety-label">
						<value>Variety</value>
					</text>

</value>

<output value="/data/seedling_batch/batch_input/crop" vellum:value="#form/seedling_batch/batch_input/crop" /> seedlings of <output value="/data/seedling_batch/batch_input/variety" vellum:value="#form/seedling_batch/batch_input/variety" />

</value>

sub count option (for debug): <output value="/data/seedling_batch/position_count" vellum:value="#form/seedling_batch/position_count" />
</value>

<output value="/data/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/cycle_time" vellum:value="#form/seedling_batch/seedling_order_summary/cycle_time" /> days

						<value>Compost Order</value>

						<value>bags</value>
					</text>

						<value>Number of bags (30kg)</value>
					</text>
					<text id="compost_order/bags/compost_delivery_date-label">
						<value>Desired delivery date</value>
					</text>
				</translation>
			</itext>
		</model>
	</h:head>
	<h:body>
		<group vellum:ref="#form/client" ref="/data/client" appearance="field-list">
			<trigger vellum:ref="#form/client/order_number1" ref="/data/client/order_number1" appearance="minimal">
				<label ref="jr:itext('client/order_number1-label')" />
			</trigger>
			<input vellum:ref="#form/client/client" ref="/data/client/client">
				<label ref="jr:itext('client/client-label')" />

 (suborder: <output value="instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/sub_order_id" vellum:value="#case/sub_order_id" /> ))
Seedlings left (before delivery): <output value="instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/number_of_seedlings_remaining" vellum:value="#case/number_of_seedlings_remaining" />


</value>
					</text>
					<text id="delivery/number_of_seedling_delivered-label">
						<value>Number of seedling delivered</value>
					</text>
					<text id="delivery/remaining_number_of_seedling_remaining-label">

<output value="/data/delivery/number_of_seedling_remaining" vellum:value="#form/delivery/number_of_seedling_remaining" /> 
</value>

		<vellum:hashtagTransforms>{"prefixes":{"#case/parent/":"instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/index/parent]/","#case/":"instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/data/case_id]/","#user/":"instance('casedb')/casedb/case[@case_type = 'commcare-user'][hq_user_id = instance('commcaresession')/session/context/userid]/"}}</vellum:hashtagTransforms>

					<value>no</value>
